title: Zstd Compression Reinstated for Pub/Sub Messages
summary: Good news! Zstd compression support for Pub/Sub messages, which was recently rolled back, has now been reinstated. Developers can once again leverage Zstd for potentially better compression ratios and performance.
details: The `schemas.Compression` object's `compressionAlgorithm` property once again includes `ZSTD` as an available enum value. This re-enables the ability for publishers to specify Zstd compression for their messages, offering an alternative to `GZIP` for optimizing data transfer and storage efficiency. This feature was previously introduced on 2026-11-11 and then temporarily removed on 2026-11-12.
